## Freed v26.7.2600-dev

Project feed items to flat rows with a losslessness proof, the locality and deletion contract, and release workflow and build-system work

### Features

- Project feed items to flat rows with a losslessness proof
- The locality and deletion contract
- Attribute renderer memory against a pre-hydration shell baseline

### Fixes

- Release build and type-safety cleanup
- Sync the roadmap layout ref after commit instead of during render
- Defer archive pruning to cloud reconciliation instead of skipping it
- Registry test filesystem race removed
- Recognize historical cloud promotions
- Align Facebook group regression with local state

### Downloads

**macOS:** `.dmg` (Apple Silicon or Intel, signed + notarized)  
**Windows:** `.exe` (NSIS installer)  
**Linux:** `.AppImage`  

> macOS downloads are signed and notarized for normal Gatekeeper installation.
